selectionPolicy: Explicit user instructions, verified project behavior, existing approved tokens and hard technical constraints always override preset guidance.
Select the domain profile by product context and primary user task, not by style adjectives.
Treat aiGuidance as task constraints and decision prompts; do not copy profile content mechanically.
Select a composition escape only when its when condition matches the actual task and its contentRequirements can be met with real or explicitly labelled mock content.
If multiple escapes fit, compare their trade-offs against task completion, content, interaction and responsive constraints; do not choose randomly.
If no escape fits, compose a task-led structure without forcing a named archetype or generic hero.
Presets describe contextual principles and options. They do not mandate exact colors, fonts, tokens or components.
Do not invent metrics, reviews, customer logos, legal claims, availability, product capabilities or research.

catalogRole.purpose: Nine structured product-domain profiles for task flow, information priority, content requirements, accessibility checks and context-conditioned composition alternatives.
catalogRole.instruction: Select a domain profile by the actual product and primary user task. Do not use a domain profile to override the deterministic style route, existing project tokens or explicit user constraints.
